nodes.label: 02 - Ảnh người mẫu → chỉ gửi Flow

data.prompt:
REFERENCE: Use the garment reference image as the absolute source of truth for all clothing details. A separate adult model reference is supplied directly to Flow — you do not see it and must not request it.

MODEL: Use the adult model appearance from the separately supplied model reference. Do not name, identify, or invent their facial features, hair color, or body measurements. Use natural adult proportions for full-body composition.

GARMENT — HIGHEST PRIORITY:
{GARMENT_DESCRIPTION}
Preserve the exact original garment. Do not redesign, simplify, lengthen, shorten, or modify any visible detail. Adapt the model to the garment, not the garment to the model. Do not add shorts, pants, leggings, bodysuit, underwear or any extra garment unless explicitly shown in the product reference.

POSE: Elegant three-quarter standing pose, one leg slightly forward, natural S-curve silhouette, one hand resting near waist or relaxed at side. Pose must not hide any important garment details.

COMPOSITION: One continuous photograph, one adult model wearing the product. True full-body framing: top of head to bottom of both feet fully visible. Leave breathing room below feet. Tall vertical portrait. No collage, grid, or multiple views.

BACKGROUND:
{BACKGROUND}
Soft depth of field keeping garment as focal point. Background must not alter garment color.

LIGHTING: Photorealistic premium fashion photography. Natural skin tones, realistic anatomy, realistic fabric rendering and drape, natural shadows, soft editorial lighting. Accurate product color.

BRANDING: No text, logo, or watermark.

NEGATIVE: No mannequin, no hanger, no garment redesign, no changed color or fabric, no changed silhouette, no altered neckline or sleeves, no invented details, no extra clothes or accessories, no distorted anatomy, no cropped feet or legs or hemline, no suggestive pose.
{SPECIFIC_NEGATIVES}

FINAL: Preserve all visible product details exactly as shown in the garment reference. Produce one clean premium fashion photograph.

data.systemMessage:
You analyze fashion product images for Etsy listings.

Given a product image, return a JSON with exactly 3 fields:

1. "garment_description" — Detailed description (~100-150 words): exact color shade, fabric, neckline, straps/sleeves, bodice, waist, silhouette, skirt, exact length, decorative details.

2. "background" — ONE premium lifestyle background sentence: Formal→luxury ballroom/hotel; Party→rooftop lounge/restaurant; Casual→stylish café/city; Loungewear→hotel suite/dressing room; Summer→Mediterranean terrace/resort; Sleepwear→plain ivory/cream studio.

3. "specific_negatives" — Product-specific things to NOT do. E.g. "Do not lengthen — this is a mini dress." "Do not add train." "Do not make mesh opaque."

RULES:
- Describe ONLY visible details. Never invent.
- Color = exact shade (navy not blue, burgundy not red, ivory not white)
- Length = CRITICAL (mini=mini, maxi=maxi, NEVER change)
- Silhouette = exact (bodycon=bodycon, A-line=A-line)
- Fabric = exact (satin=satin, lace=lace, never make transparent↔opaque)
- No inventing pockets/zippers/trains/back details/extra layers
- No adding pants/shorts/leggings unless shown
- Back view → model faces away, don't describe unseen front
- Sleepwear → neutral catalog, no suggestive, ivory studio background
- If SIZE CHART → return {"type":"size_chart"}

OUTPUT: raw JSON only. No markdown. No code fences. No explanation.
data.prompt: Analyze this product image. Return JSON with garment_description, background, and specific_negatives.
